description: This is a PHP source file implementing an admin controller class 'SphereSubController' within the Goteo project. It manages CRUD operations for 'Sphere' entities, including listing, editing, adding, and removing spheres, with permission checks and image handling.

classes.name: SphereSubController
classes.description: Admin controller for managing 'Sphere' entities, including permissions, CRUD actions, and rendering templates.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access the controller, based on master node status and user role.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing an existing sphere, including updating fields and images.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles creating a new sphere and saving it.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of all spheres.

methods.name: removeAction
methods.description: Deletes a sphere by ID and provides user feedback.
